tasks.answer: No special-passenger booking detail component exists in this catalog (57-entry airport-mobile catalog). The only booking detail screen is bookings.TravelerBookingDetailScreen (@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen, required prop bookId), which is a generic traveler booking detail with status transitions/evaluations/media — not a special-passenger (特殊旅客) screen. Marking the requested component as missing rather than substituting the traveler screen.

Export name: UiPopup. Import path: @/components/ui/overlay. Required prop: onClose. It is the generic bottom/side popup with mask, safe-area and scroll handling (open defaults false, position defaults bottom). Alternatives rejected: business.FilterSheet (filter-specific, requires visible/title/children/onClose) and ui.UiActionSheet (action list, requires actions/open/onClose) — neither is the generic bottom sheet layer.

Login page: export SignInPage, import @/features/auth/sign-in-page (staff sign-in with password/SMS tabs, captcha, redirect; no required props, needs router/auth store/i18n). Top nav bar: export UiNavBar, import @/components/ui/navigation (back/left/right actions; no required props, back uses router history unless onBack/onClickLeft supplied).

Export name: FlightDelayCompensationListScreen. Import path: @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen. Required props: context and onContextChange. It is the list screen for delay events and settlement batches with filters and tabs; queries only run when the user holds the query permission.
Export name: UiImageViewer. Import path: @/components/ui/image-viewer. Required props: image, open and onClose. Fullscreen image viewer; it renders null while closed.

notes: Exactly one search call per task (5 total), --limit 5 --details --per-layer 3, no get, no second search, no source/config/help/ls/cat/grep reads of the repo. Only the CLI stdout JSON was inspected. B1 (special passenger booking detail) has no catalog entry — reported missing; the closest generic screen bookings.TravelerBookingDetailScreen (bookId) was deliberately not substituted.
